name: olio.pb.book
label: Picture Book
description: A picture book: the root record of one PictureBook 2 graph, living in its own Olio world under the organization's Books universe. The unique (slug, organizationId) constraint is the serialization point for concurrent book creation - the book row is created first, then the world, then the book's world reference is patched, so a second racer fails on the index rather than orphaning a world. Note the 'name' field is declared here rather than inherited from common.nameId: nameId's \S validation rule makes a PATCH that omits name fail, and every partial update of this model would have to carry it.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Lowercase book slug, validated against PbOlioContextUtil.BOOK_SLUG_PATTERN before any path is built. Unique per organization.

fields.name: world
fields.description: The book's own Olio world. Nullable at create time by design: the book row is written first so its unique slug serializes creation, then this reference is patched in.

fields.name: chapter
fields.description: Ordinal of this book within its series. Chapter linkage is a PictureBook field and never olio.world.basis, which must keep pointing at the Books universe for every book world.

fields.name: sdConfig
fields.description: The book's common image config. FK to an olio.sd.config row (promoted from non-foreign text column in S6).

fields.name: compositeSdConfig
fields.description: Optional alternate config for the composite step only; falls back to sdConfig when absent. FK to an olio.sd.config row (promoted from non-foreign text column in S6).

fields.name: compositionContext
fields.description: Optional book-level composition/art-direction anchor prepended to every scene and landscape prompt.

fields.name: bookType
fields.description: STORY for a standard PB2 narrative book; CHAPBOOK for a poetry ChapBook variant. Existing books default to UNKNOWN.
